milestones.name: Monorepo scaffold + shared types
steps: Initialize Turborepo workspace (turbo.json, root package.json workspaces)
Scaffold apps/api (NestJS skeleton)
Scaffold apps/web (Vite + React + TS)
Create packages/shared with Product/CartItem/Order/DTO types
Wire apps/api and apps/web to depend on packages/shared
Root scripts: dev/build/test/lint
Unit: smoke test per app confirming workspace wiring

milestones.name: API: products + in-memory store + seed
steps: In-memory ProductsRepository (CRUD)
Seed 8-10 starter products across flavor/topping/combo
ProductsController: GET /products, GET /products/:id
Unit: repository CRUD, seed shape, availability filtering
Integration: GET /products and GET /products/:id happy path + 404

milestones.name: API: orders + admin auth + admin CRUD
steps: OrdersRepository + OrdersController POST /orders with server-side pricing and validation
AdminAuthController: POST /admin/login, POST /admin/logout via env creds + HttpOnly JWT cookie
AdminGuard protecting /admin/* and product-mutation routes
Guarded POST/PATCH/DELETE /products + admin-only includeUnavailable query
GET /admin/orders (guarded)
Unit: total calculation, admin credential check, guard rejection
Integration: order creation incl. rejection paths, admin login success/failure, guarded routes, admin CRUD round-trip

milestones.name: Frontend: menu, cart, checkout, confirmation
steps: API client module using packages/shared types
Cart context (React context + localStorage, cleared post-order)
Routes: /, /cart, /checkout, /order/:id
Inline checkout error handling
Unit: cart context reducer logic, price/total formatting
Playwright: golden path browse→cart→checkout→confirmation + one negative case

milestones.name: Frontend: admin login, menu management, orders view
steps: /admin/login page + auth-gated /admin/menu and /admin/orders with redirect
/admin/menu: product table with inline create/edit/delete
/admin/orders: read-only list newest first
Unit: admin auth-gate redirect logic, menu-table edit/delete state
Playwright: admin golden path login→add product→visible on public menu→guest orders it→visible in admin orders
